alt: AgiBot G2 humanoid robots working at a convenience store during the 'Robots Never Clock Out' trial, stocking shelves and performing tasks alongside human staff
story: On November 4, 2026, AgiBot ran a 24-hour 'Robots Never Clock Out' trial with six G2 humanoid robots at a convenience store; four were promoted to official employees, but two were dismissed from their probationary period — one for 'slacking off' and lacking 'on-duty enthusiasm,' and one for being unable to keep up with the pace.
why_funny: The robots designed to outperform every human worker, marketed under the slogan 'Robots Never Clock Out,' had to be let go from their first job for underperforming and having a bad attitude.
